sources.title: Cloudroom README
sources.locator: Hero runtime diagram; Why it exists; What's in this repo; Get started; How the cloud works; Security
sources.finding: Cloudroom runs any coding-agent harness in the cloud. Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode and others run as their own CLIs, each in an isolated sandbox with its own Git branch. A running session can move between Mac and cloud via Teleport. For Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 13+), Linux x64 and Windows 11. Repo holds gui/ desktop app built on BB, core/ Rust service, skills/. Download app, self-host on Ubuntu 24.04 via install.sh, or build from source (Rust 1.89+). Agents run as separate Linux user without admin; API needs secret token; history stays on own disk; agents run without approval prompts.

sources.title: HTTP API reference
sources.locator: Conventions; Sessions; History; Accounts; Workspaces/sync/previews/transfers; Errors
sources.finding: Every feature over plain HTTP 127.0.0.1:9840 with Bearer token. POST returns 202 accepted (not completed); request_id 1-64 chars dedupes. Sessions: latest 1,000, POST creates cr_<id> with harness/model/reasoning/provider/workspace, parent_session starts child cr_child_<id>, fork/side-chat support, relay for cross-sandbox children. Commands prompts/edit/cancel/reorder/steer/interrupt/stop/resume/sleep/compact/rewind/attachments/close plus secrets. Events/stream paged 256 records; states pending/running/idle/sleeping/closed/failed etc. Accounts endpoints for codex/claude/cursor/pi logins. Terminals websocket PTY, teleports, mac jobs, previews.

sources.title: Run Cloudroom on Ubuntu 24.04
sources.locator: Quick install; Service accounts; Saved history; Configure; First task; Cloud folders; Connect desktop; Own server vs Cloud
sources.finding: Fresh VM for one trusted user (sudo, systemd, cgroup v2). install.sh checks checksum, installs Node 24, creates cloudroom/cloudroom-agent accounts, writes /etc/cloudroom/core.env token, starts service. Build from source with Rust. History: self-hosted journal on machine (CLOUDROOM_LOCAL_HISTORY=1, back up yourself) vs managed sandboxes upload to website object storage. Cloud folders: POST workspace creates empty dir under /code, agent can clone. Desktop connects via Settings with HTTPS URL+token (v83+). Own server: Codex/Pi, Cloud threads, Mac access, previews, synced skills; Cloud-only: GPUs, Cloud loops, computer use, phone while Mac off, one sandbox per thread. Tailscale Serve for remote; never funnel.

sources.title: Session lifecycle and replay
sources.locator: Sleep idle sessions; Queued prompts and restart; Recovery preflight; Storage and replay
sources.finding: After 30 min without activity core stops harness and marks sleeping; prompt/teleport/resume wakes same native conversation. Queued prompts run in order; interrupt stops turn only; close releases slot preserving history. Normal shutdown leaves suspended; restarts resume saved Codex conversation; deliberately closed stay closed. Recovery GET reports ready/empty/missing/unavailable; POST resume restarts process_lost after cleanup. Journal fsynced, snapshot every 20k records, compaction off until readers support segments. Shutdown signals harnesses, 5s diagnostics, 6s HTTP drain; distinct from client disconnect which never stops execution.

sources.title: Disk safety
sources.locator: Behavior thresholds; Sync recovery; Provisioning; Containers
sources.finding: Warn at 5GB or less, block new work/uploads and freeze agents below 2GB, resume above 2.5GB. Failed measurements block work. Requires Linux, protected service account, delegated cgroups; agent paths share monitored filesystem. Containers without cgroups run in container mode (CLOUDROOM_WORKLOAD tags, signals). Provisioning binds 127.0.0.1:9840, storage.json policy with warning/pause/resume bytes. Upgrade path for quota VMs preserves files/credentials/history.

sources.title: Dashboard API
sources.locator: GET /v1/dashboard JSON; Metric history
sources.finding: Dashboard uses same bearer token, reads registry and cached 10s resource sample; returns version, sampledAt, runtime ready/configured, resources cpu/memory/disk, resourceBytes, diskThresholds, agents working/queued/waiting/failed/background, storage level normal/low_space/blocked, onboarding, capabilities settings/updates false, sessionCount, latest 1,000 sessions with id/title/repository/harness/model/state/activity. Titles generic, no receipts/prompts/paths/credentials. Settings/updates unsupported (clients must not call without capabilities.updates true). Website derives charts from uploaded resources diagnostics.

sources.title: Localhost cloud previews
sources.locator: Commands; Machines without inbound SSH; API; Security and limits
sources.finding: Agent runs HTTP dev server, room-cli preview PORT posts URL; laptop URL like http://p3000-xxxx.localhost:3000 via paired Mac helper or tunnel mode (websocket Upgrade cloudroom-tunnel) for hosted/self-hosted. Registry in protected state dir; helper binds loopback, exact Host/Origin checks. Only non-privileged IPv4-loopback agent-owned ports, core/SSH ports excluded. One paired Mac supported. Same-origin HTTP/WS/SSE supported; HTTPS-only dev servers unsupported. Close/revoke ends SSH connections. Closed laptops cannot serve localhost.

sources.title: Diagnostics
sources.locator: Recorded data; Storage and limits; Claude login monitoring; Protected harness stderr
sources.finding: Diagnostics POST to CLOUDROOM_API_URL (website ClickHouse 90d CPU/7d rest) covering api/route/latency, agent_start/exit, auth_health (Claude credential presence + last inference outcome, 5-min checks), computer_use calls, history_upload, resources CPU/memory/disk every 10s plus per-minute top programs/idle-burn, mac_pairing, storage_stale. Local jsonl 8MiB rotation, 1s batches, 5-min uploads. No credentials/prompts/paths/bodies in diagnostics. Raw stderr tail (16KiB, 2KB files, 1MiB cap, 0700/0600) saved for failed/lost sessions only.

sources.finding: Connection in ~/.gui-cloudroom cloudroom.json (url/token/projectId 0600) via POST /api/v1/cloudroom. Use room-cli not bb; standalone defaults 127.0.0.1:39886 daemon 39887; room-cli status/thread/machine commands same backend for Local and Cloud threads. Packaged app uses server 39886/daemon 39887 and ~/.gui-cloudroom. Push notifications plugin has webEnabled/desktopEnabled true default; browsers need HTTPS/localhost + permission; bb push-notifications test broadcasts. Keep Awake runs caffeinate on selected macOS hosts; closing lid still sleeps. Telemetry disabled via Settings Privacy or bb settings general telemetryEnabled false or BB_TELEMETRY=false.

sources.locator: Managed worktree; Start thread in worktree; Move running thread; .worktreeinclude; .bb-env-setup.sh
sources.finding: Managed worktree is git worktree of project repo on fresh branch at <DATA>/plugins/environment-git-worktree/host-data/worktrees/<thread>/<repo>; shares .git, cheap, parallel threads. Pick Worktree in environment picker or pnpm bb thread spawn --new-environment worktree. room-cli thread worktree moves Local thread keeping ID/chat; uncommitted files stay unless --carry (Claude/Codex only). .worktreeinclude copies untracked files (gitignore syntax) before setup; .bb-env-setup.sh runs inside owned path (15-min timeout, failure blocks provisioning).
